completionMeaning: All 20 scope items were assessed. Partial means at least one requested behavior failed or remains unverified.

scopeSource.description: Private original scope note, summarized without copying its contents or attachments.

focusedRuns.name: horizontal fill and Backspace range clear
focusedRuns.fixture: fresh copy of synthetic delivery2 ticket-39 data with a second numeric column

checks.item6HorizontalFill: pass: dragged 100 into the adjacent numeric cell, left other rows unchanged, then undo restored the empty column
checks.item14Backspace: pass: Backspace cleared two Shift+Arrow-selected cells, left the third row and row count unchanged, and undo restored values

focusedRuns.name: mouse range selection, Delete, and undo
focusedRuns.fixture: same retained synthetic fixture, seeded with two populated numeric columns
focusedRuns.initialAttempt: At 15:14 the range also selected four cells, but a row-label extraction returned blanks and stopped before Delete. The selector was corrected to use row indices for this successful focused rerun.

focusedRuns.name: canonical inline versus linked item 11 comparison
focusedRuns.fixture: fresh synthetic fixture with a canonical [[Financeiro]] embed and two linked views using identical configuration
findings: Inline body font is 13.5px with automatic table layout; linked body font is 12.15px with fixed layout.
Inline header and body cells are transparent; linked header uses rgba(20,20,30,0.05) and linked body cells are white.
Header and body cell border styles differ.

items.title: Block color samples and custom HEX
findings: The standard color samples matched their applied block colors.
A custom HEX color applied and persisted after reopening.

items.title: Compact filter bar
items.qualification: Functional behavior passed; compactness has limited visual evidence and was not stress-tested with multiple filters in a narrow window. This is not a reproduced product defect.
findings: Delivery2 ticket #28 applied a temporary filter, verified the matching rows, reset it, and opened the filter section from the options panel.
The compactness judgment is qualified because the run did not capture a dedicated geometry comparison.

items.title: Image context menu and actions
findings: Right-click opened the image menu with replace, caption, three alignments, and crop.
Alignment, caption, crop, canceled replacement, applied replacement, and reopened presentation were checked.

items.title: Full-width layout and menu behavior
findings: Full width and unclipped menu geometry passed at 1600×1000 and 800×600.
The property settings popover overlapped the icon picker and blocked controls in a reproduced scenario. This is the main reason item 4 remains partial; the same scenario is recorded under item 20.
As an additional usability observation, Escape closed the style panel and restored focus, but the page options menu remained open.

items.title: Hierarchical collapsible headings
findings: Collapse is opt-in; the control appears only on enabled headings.
Nested content hides within its section, following sections remain visible, disabling restores content, and collapsed state persisted after reopening.

items.title: Table keyboard, clipboard, and fill interactions
findings: Delivery4 covered keyboard navigation and editing, Enter/Tab behavior, cell selection, clipboard, Shift+arrow selection, and vertical fill.
A focused hidden-UI check dragged the fill handle horizontally from 100 into an adjacent numeric column, verified other rows stayed unchanged, and confirmed undo restored the empty destination.

items.title: Edit column menu action
findings: The rendered column menu contains the short label ‘Editar coluna’; selecting it opens column settings.
evidence: Focused UI result in docs/evidence/original-scope-audit-2026-10-28.json; see item 7 check in the authorized verification script.

items.title: Conditional formatting color and formula preview
findings: Nine color samples rendered, custom HEX preview matched #3157C8, and formula Valor >= 200 colored only matching values after reopen.

items.title: Collapse linked views and hide title
findings: A linked view collapses and expands.
Enabling Hide title still leaves the source title Financeiro visible.
The collapse/expand cycle produced a renderer error: Selection passed to setSelection must point at the current document.
evidence: Focused UI run at 2026-10-28T14:59:40.613Z; linked collapse/hide-title result is recorded here and the renderer error is captured in execution.focusedRuns.

items.title: Right-side table options and linked views
findings: The options panel shows filtering, sorting, layout, properties, calculation, conditional formatting, hide-title/collapse toggles, and two linked views.
All four user-defined properties appear in the list; the implicit title column does not.
The toolbar still has six direct controls plus Options, seven buttons total.

items.title: Linked-view appearance and independent rename
findings: Renaming one linked view left its sibling and source title unchanged and persisted after reopening.
A canonical inline [[Financeiro]] embed and linked view with identical view configuration and 774px table width were compared at the same 1600×1000 viewport.
Styles differ: inline table/body text is 13.5px with automatic layout versus 12.15px and fixed layout for linked; header/body backgrounds and borders also differ.

items.title: Summary footer alignment and independent calculations
findings: Independent summaries persisted: primary sum 600 and count 3; review maximum 300.
Unset cells show Calcular.
The body value 100 is left aligned while the footer maximum 300 is right aligned; the footer is not aligned to the body column. Hover-only discretion was not established.

items.title: Seven-column layout and drag insertion
findings: An external paragraph dragged into an existing six-column group created a seventh column with a visible insertion indicator and persisted after reopening.
A separate attempt to create an eighth column was rejected with the seven-column limit message.

items.title: Mouse/keyboard range selection and Backspace/Delete clearing
findings: Shift+arrow rectangular selection, Delete clearing, and undo passed in delivery4.
A focused check selected two cells with Shift+Arrow, cleared them with Backspace, kept the third row and row count unchanged, and restored values with undo.
A mouse drag selected the intended 2×2 range across two numeric columns; Delete cleared all four cells without removing rows, and undo restored all four values.

items.title: Row handle, row actions, and select-all
findings: Clicking or right-clicking the six-dot row handle neither selects the row nor opens its menu.
Checkbox selection and select-all/deselect-all work; the separate More menu shows eight row actions.

items.title: Property-type search and icons
findings: Search for number returns Número; search for Número returns Telefone and Número.
All 25 property types display representative icons to the left of their names.

items.title: Formula relation tokens and suggestions
findings: Relation tokens have a rounded outline and distinct color; related-field suggestions appear.
Tab inserts the selected reference, its binding persists after reopen, and the panel stays inside the viewport.

items.title: Number formatting for formula results
findings: All seven applicable number display controls matched between Formula→Number and a standard Number property; manual-fill controls were excluded.

items.title: Create or link inverse relation
findings: Linking an existing inverse relation, merging its union, and persisting after reopen passed under delivery3 ticket #43.
Creating a new inverse from a clean source relation failed with toast ‘Both properties must be relation properties.’; no inverse property or reciprocal metadata was saved.

items.title: Default and uploaded property icons
findings: Representative type icons are present; a custom PNG upload saved and rendered after reopening.
The PNG displays at 200×400px against an expected 14px column icon size.
One earlier run found the upload control covered by the Description field; the later run hit the upload control with the pointer.
